purpose_zh: 全路径逐项许可披露：对 manifest.json 登记的每个文件声明许可、归属、再分发条件与边界说明；服务于『可公开复算』宣称与许可的一致性。
purpose_en: Per-path rights disclosure: licence, attribution, redistribution condition and boundary note for every file registered in manifest.json; aligns the 'publicly recomputable' claim with the package licence.
disclaimer_zh: 本披露为提交者自查，非独立法律意见；许可升级（COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY → CC-BY-SA-4.0）自 v2.10 起生效，此前版本的公开历史记录仍按其当时许可表述理解。
disclaimer_en: This inventory is a submitter self-review, not independent legal advice. The licence upgrade (COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY -> CC-BY-SA-4.0) takes effect from v2.10; the public history of earlier versions remains governed by the licence statement of those versions.
licence_upgrade_note_zh: 主许可升级不改变三类既有边界：(1) 内嵌 Noto Sans SC 字体子集仍归 SIL OFL-1.1；(2) SEB 与折返协议的采纳组件仍归原规范作者（lqqk7 / chucky1102）及其许可；(3) 渲染所用的操作系统随附字体与依赖库不随包分发。
licence_upgrade_note_en: The main-licence upgrade changes neither (1) the SIL OFL-1.1 licence of the embedded Noto Sans SC subsets, nor (2) the original authors and licences of adopted components (SEB by lqqk7; Switchback Protocol by chucky1102), nor (3) the non-redistribution of OS-bundled fonts and dependency libraries.

manifest_hash_binding.note_zh: 路径清单与逐文件内容哈希以 manifest.json 为准；对任意公开 commit 可离线核验（git show <commit>:<path> 后计算 sha256 对照）。
manifest_hash_binding.note_en: The path list and per-file content hashes of record are those in manifest.json; verifiable offline against any public commit (git show <commit>:<path>, then compare sha256).

entries.notes_en: Package file registry; per-file sha256 values inside are the content hash of record.
